This post is created to give users the run down on how to submit a parts list from which others can give them advice on their build.

The easiest tool to use is www.pcpartpicker.com below is a step by step list on how to create a list and submit.

  1. After loading www.pcpartpicker.com select the option "Start a System Build" located at the top of the page.
  2. From here it will present a list of components and prompts you to select them individually. I would recommend selecting your cpu first.
  3. Be sure to use the tools on the left of the page to narrow your search results. Use these tools to limit your search based on your price or compatibility with parts already chosen.( for example once you pick your cpu you could narrow your motherboard search by selecting only parts using the correct socket).
  4. After you have assembled your list you will see there is a section above the parts list titled markup. Select the little reddit(2nd from the left) and now you may copy and paste it into your post.
